purpose: Source of the analyzer behaviour cited for alert #641 (java/missing-case-in-switch)

relevant_lines: 534:     exists(Expr e | e.getParent() = this and e.getIndex() >= 0 and not e instanceof PatternExpr) and
535:     // For backward compatibility, we don't include `case null, default:` here, on the assumption
536:     // this will come as a surprise to CodeQL that predates that statement's validity.

reading: nthMissing treats an enum constant as covered only when it equals switch.getAConstCase().getValue(), and ConstCase.getValue() is the case constant at index 0. The second label of a multi-label case (case TIMEOUT, UNKNOWN_STATE ->) is therefore reported as missing.
